term:
by
  have h : ∀ t acc, treeAcc (mirror t) acc = (flatten t).reverse ++ acc := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | leaf x =>
        intro acc
        simp [treeAcc, mirror, flatten]
    | fork l r ihl ihr =>
        intro acc
        simp only [mirror, treeAcc, ihl, ihr, flatten]
        simp [List.reverse_append, List.append_assoc]
  simpa using h t []
